levels.name: Read to the end
levels.completion_criterion: Read the recipe once before you turn on the heat.
levels.can_do: You can read before you cook.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not substitute an allergen. Do not start a deep-fry you have not planned.

levels.name: Set the ingredients out
levels.completion_criterion: Set out every ingredient the recipe names, or mark the one you do not have.
levels.can_do: You can discover a gap before cooking.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not substitute an allergen. Do not start a deep-fry you have not planned.

levels.name: Adapt or stop
levels.completion_criterion: Either substitute an ingredient you can justify or choose not to start, and say which.
levels.can_do: You can stop or adapt before the heat is on.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not substitute an allergen. Do not start a deep-fry you have not planned.
